description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewayNodeSession component of the OpenClawKit project, specifically testing WebSocket session behaviors, token handling, URL normalization, and timeout behavior.

classes.name: FakeGatewayWebSocketTask
classes.description: A mock implementation of WebSocketTasking to simulate WebSocket interactions for testing GatewayNodeSession.

classes.name: FakeGatewayWebSocketSession
classes.description: A mock WebSocketSessioning that creates and manages FakeGatewayWebSocketTasks for testing.

classes.name: SeqGapProbe
classes.description: A simple actor class used to detect whether a sequence gap message has been observed during tests.

classes.name: GatewayNodeSessionTests
classes.description: A test suite containing various tests for GatewayNodeSession behaviors such as token handling, URL normalization, timeout handling, and reconnection sequence gaps.

methods.name: scannedSetupCodePrefersBootstrapAuthOverStoredDeviceToken
methods.description: Tests that the bootstrap token is preferred over a stored device token during WebSocket connection setup.

methods.name: bootstrapHelloStoresAdditionalDeviceTokens
methods.description: Verifies that the bootstrap handshake correctly stores additional device tokens provided in the hello message.

methods.name: nonBootstrapHelloStoresPrimaryDeviceTokenButNotAdditionalBootstrapTokens
methods.description: Tests that non-bootstrap handshakes store only the primary device token.

methods.name: untrustedBootstrapHelloDoesNotPersistBootstrapHandoffTokens
methods.description: Ensures bootstrap handshakes from untrusted sources do not persist bootstrap tokens.

methods.name: normalizeCanvasHostUrlPreservesExplicitSecureCanvasPort
methods.description: Validates that explicitly specified secure ports in the URL are preserved in normalization.

methods.name: normalizeCanvasHostUrlBackfillsGatewayHostForLoopbackCanvas
methods.description: Checks that the normalization function backfills the correct host for loopback URLs.

methods.name: invokeWithTimeoutReturnsUnderlyingResponseBeforeTimeout
methods.description: Ensures a successful invocation returns the response before the timeout triggers.

methods.name: invokeWithTimeoutReturnsTimeoutError
methods.description: Checks that timeout during invocation results in a timeout error with proper message.

methods.name: invokeWithTimeoutZeroDisablesTimeout
methods.description: Verifies that a zero timeout disables the timeout mechanism entirely.

methods.name: emitsSyntheticSeqGapAfterReconnectSnapshot
methods.description: Tests that a synthetic sequence gap event is emitted after a reconnect snapshot.
